description.value:
♐ Sagittarius is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake and you have your Ascendant Boon for the whole day.

You gain a fly Speed equal to your Speed.

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Golden Arrow]'s range increment becomes one mile; it ignores all cover, concealment, and the hidden and undetected conditions, and can strike any creature whose location you can name even without line of sight. Its damage rises one step on the spine.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.
